name: Starbeam Ventures Limited
about: Starbeam Ventures Limited engages in film production and content creation in India. It creates, produces, and distributes movies. The company also provides end-to-end production services, including film and web series production; music video direction; script writing and concept development; post-production and editing; casting and talent management; and production design and cinematography. The company was formerly known as Bluegod Entertainment Limited and changed its name to Starbeam Ventures Limited in April 2026. Starbeam Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
